subject.title: feat(zalouser): surface inbound photo attachments via media array

question: Should Zalo inbound attachment metadata be allowed to trigger the standard remote-media download path with the branch's timeout, redaction, classification, and fallback controls?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but accepting automatically fetched third-party media URLs is an owner-level security and availability boundary rather than a mechanical code-review choice.

options.title: Accept the bounded standard path
options.body: Confirm that plugin SDK media safeguards plus the 10-second idle and 30-second total limits are sufficient, then merge after required checks complete.

options.title: Require stricter Zalo validation
options.body: Require an approved Zalo CDN policy, byte sniffing, or additional redirect and size assertions before enabling automatic downloads.

options.title: Keep photos tool-driven
options.body: Decline automatic attachment fetching and retain the current text or image-tool workflow despite its lower reliability and added latency.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded standard path
recommendation.body: Confirm that plugin SDK media safeguards plus the 10-second idle and 30-second total limits are sufficient, then merge after required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly inspected and simplified the pinned zca-js contract in this channel, providing the strongest available ownership signal.
